acceptance_predicates.description: Provider/model/auth defaults are validated and persisted atomically with crash-safe replacement.
Defaults can apply to selected or all configured agents without invalid tuples.
Cancellation, validation failure and restart preserve the prior valid configuration.
Only redacted credential references are persisted and diagnostics are human-readable or opt-in JSON.
Missing authentication, signatures and key management remain warning-only in development.
Exact protected-main merge and all required hosted/exact-main checks are recorded in the receipt.

definition_of_done: Merged exact-main implementation passes persistence, restart, rollback and inventory gates.
Post-merge receipt records exact protected-main head and independent review evidence.

inputs.description: Released provider/model/auth and adapter compatibility catalog.

outputs.description: Atomic selected/all-agent defaults persistence and reconfiguration flow.

gates.description: All required PR and exact-main checks pass on merged head.
